data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next=500 or100. Recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run benefit is uncertain. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Each: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
